all_minutes: Report all 60 heads with each own mature observed nonzero target, counts and proper scores. Use simultaneous maximum-absolute-deviation day and week AUC bands across all 60; do not select the best minute.
candidate: One fresh 60-head compact eight-family native model, one fixed-seed B16 pass over the same chronological TRAIN prefix, using the separately qualified exact-decimal target. Qualification weights are never reused.
fixed_comparison: Compare the new 5-minute logits with the original 60-head one-pass logits on the identical mature observed nonzero corrected 5-minute targets and exact parent/decision identities. Report AUC, fixed 0.5-threshold accuracy, logloss and Brier; compare accuracy and proper scores with a fixed own-TRAIN class prior and always-UP. Do not fit a later threshold or select a checkpoint.
limits: Q1 2025 is reused development data; the procedure precedes this new fit but is not an untouched confirmation.
Matching 256 initial predictions and fixed data identities does not independently prove every feature value or full-training input parity.
Candle-open midpoint direction is not evidence of executable fills, costs, FLAT selectivity or profit.
primary_uncertainty: Use fixed 10,000 paired UTC-day and UTC-week block-bootstrap draws for new-minus-original AUC and new-minus-0.5 AUC. Bonferroni alpha 0.05/4 for the four intervals; require both day and week lower limits above zero for a directional ranking claim. Report proper-score intervals separately.
